    Comfort and style with every step: the latest boots drop at Pavers has something for everyone - including wide fits

    A huge range, affordable prices, it's time to get your boot wardrobe sorted

    By Rivkie Baum
    Published 13 hours ago In News

    When you purchase through links on our site, we may earn an affiliate commission. Here’s how it works.

    Instaread

    Boot season is here. The weather has finally cooled and I, for one, am ready to make the switch. Goodbye sandals, hello, closed footwear. I absolutely love boots, but I have to admit they don't always love me back. Thanks to wide calves and not being the biggest heel wearer, I feel like shoe shopping can be my nemesis, so I was really surprised at the vast collection at Pavers that combines both comfort and style.

    The latest autumn collection, The Boot Shop, is fronted by none other than Nicki Chapman, who is a big fan of the brand, and fronts the Yorkshire-based label's latest advert. The presenter, radio host and former Pop Idol judge has really involved herself in the edit, and it really is wearable, elegant and for every occasion.

    And for those, like me, who need wider fits, Pavers absolutely have you covered, thanks to wider and higher toe boxes that look sleek and yet accommodate the foot, and the cleverest adjustable leather knee-high boots; there is no compromise here when it comes to style and comfort. With a range of heel heights from flat to chunky or slim cones, there really is a feeling that Pavers just want you to look and feel good.
    Pavers
    Smart Block Heel Ankle Boots With Warm Lining
    £44.99 (RRP £64.99) at Pavers

    These leopard print boots have already been a huge hit, selling through and being restocked in quick succession. Leopard print is a perennial trend, and the lovely dark colourway of this design ensures they're elegant and polished. The small heel ensures you can wear these from AM to PM with dresses and jeans.

    Pavers
    Wide Fit Leather Long Boots
    £89.99 (RRP £134.99) at Pavers

    The cleverest boots you'll ever meet, this sleek pair of toffee coloured riding boots feature beautiful gold hardware, and I love the detailing a the heel, but the thing that really has me reaching for my credit card? The second zip down the back. The inner fastening is to help you get it on and off. The one at the back? It widens the boot silhouette, so whether you need more calf room, or want to tuck your jeans in, it's adjustable - genius.

    Pavers
    Smart Block Heel Ankle Boots With Buckle Detail
    £47.99 (RRP £67.99) at Pavers

    I can't believe these boots are under £50. While the RRP is £69.99, Pavers have them for £20, making these an early autumn style steal. The gold buckle detailing creates a luxe finish that will look great with trending bohemian dresses or your favourite denim. The small block heel adds height and style, without compromising on comfort.

    Pavers
    Wide Fit Leather Long Boots
    £89.99 (RRP £134.99) at Pavers

    In classic black, with gold trim hardware, like the toffee hued iteration, this boot is made for a host of leg widths, as the zipper at the back means you can adjust the fit to your calf, or create more space in your boot if you want to tuck in jeans. A supremely clever design, these leather boots are under £90, which feels like a tall order these days.
    Pavers
    Cone-Heeled Smart Ankle Boots
    £44.99 at Pavers

    Embellished shoes are the speediest way to dress up a jeans and a jumper outfit and these embellished booties, with a sleek and slim fit ankle cut will work effortlessly with denim and beyond. The all over detailing will ensure you shimmer with every step, and thanks to the almost sock-boot like ankle shaft, you can wear these with tights and dresses or skirts too.

    Pavers
    Wide Fit Smart Long Boots
    £49.99 (RRP £47.99) at Pavers

    I love a suede boot and whilst we have some rain-free days, now is the time to get out and enjoy this sumptuous and expensive looking fabric. The suede boots with gold heel detailing echo the leather looks in the tall boot collection, but I love how polished this style is, whilst still maintaining a flat block heel. Oh, and they're wide fit too.

    I'm not surprised the leopard print boots have already had to have a restock, every single pair in this list are lovely in real life and with such affordable prices for comfort-first footwear, it's hard not to buy multiples.

    I love that the brand has embraced the latest autumn/winter fashion trends for 2026 alongside practical, timeless style and comfort-in-mind design, because we shouldn't be crawling home at the end of a work day with painful feet.

    You may like

    • UGG season has begun, and Sharon Stone's cosy boots and navy coat combination is perfect for the cold weather ahead
    • Jennifer Lawrence kicks off UGG season in the classic boots that work with wide-leg trousers and jeans

    A pair of well-looked-after leather boots should last for years, just make sure to clean them regularly and re-heel or re-sole as needed, because this will help to extend the life of your shoes and boots. Start with the classics, a pair of great knee highs in black, tan or chocolate brown will go with almost anything, and deliver autumn polish with ease.

    After that, experiment, try suede, opt for slouchy cuts for a more bohemian finish, or try Chelsea boots for a bit more of a trending style.
